metadata.scenario: A patient calls to move their Thursday appointment to Friday same time because of a plumber coming to their house. Simple reschedule, no issues. The receptionist confirms Friday at 2 PM.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is Jennifer Taylor. I need to reschedule my grandmother's companion care appointment. Of course, Jennifer. When was the original appointment? It was scheduled for this Thursday at 2 PM. Got it. What day would you like to move it to? I’d like to move it to Friday at the same time, if that’s possible. Let me check our schedule for Friday at 2 PM. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. I just need to do it because a plumber is coming to the house on Thursday. Thank you for your patience, Jennifer. I see that we have availability on Friday at 2 PM. Great! Can you confirm that for me? Yes, I can confirm your grandmother’s appointment for Friday at 2 PM. Perfect. Is there anything else I need to do? No, just ensure she is ready for the caregiver when they arrive. Got it! Oh, can you remind me of the services included again? Absolutely. The companion care includes social interaction, assistance with daily activities, and light housekeeping. That sounds good. What’s the price for that service? The price for companion care is $25 to $30 per hour, depending on the caregiver's experience. Okay, thank you for that information. You're welcome! Is there anything else you’d like assistance with today? Actually, my grandmother might also need help managing her medications. We can definitely help with that. Our medication management service ranges from $65 to $80. That sounds like a good idea. Can I schedule that for her as well? Yes, I can assist with that. Would you like to set it for the same day, Friday? Yes, Friday sounds good. What time do you recommend? Since the companion care is at 2 PM, we could schedule the medication management for 1 PM. That works for me! Let’s go ahead and book it. Perfect! I’ll schedule the medication management for Friday at 1 PM. Thank you so much for your help today! You’re very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with? No, that’s all for now. Thanks again! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, Jennifer. Have a wonderful day! You too, bye!
